files_touched: `NoteTaker/code/notetaker_watcher.ps1` -- added `Send-SupabaseKeepAlive` (a CORS OPTIONS ping the Edge Function answers 200 before any auth, no secret/audio) fired on watcher startup and every 12h, so the project never crosses Supabase's 7-day inactivity pause threshold.

`INSTALL.md` (new) -- single onboarding doc: accounts/licenses table (paid ones flagged), software + npm CLIs, and an agent-executable runbook with HUMAN STEP markers at the account/payment/OAuth/key-generation points.
